title: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
abstract: arXiv:2611.26912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing complexity of electronic systems demands efficient design flows, yet EDA scripting remains a bottleneck: proprietary APIs are sparsely documented, and errors often appear as silent failures or cryptic exceptions. Hand-crafted knowledge helps but is difficult to maintain as toolchains evolve. We present ZhuLong-SE (Self-Evolution), an execution-grounded LLM agent that learns reusable knowledge from prior task traces. Building on ZhuLong, it enhances the task-level harness with API retrieval, documentation responses, isolated sandbox execution, and static checking, then adds governed cross-task self-evolution. Beyond solving individual tasks, ZhuLong-SE distills past execution traces into a three-tier memory store governed by ground-truth anchoring, disconfirmation filtering, held-out rollback, and anti-leakage retrieval. translated_title: 面向EDA脚本编写：超越人工构建经验的自进化方法
translated_abstract: 电子系统日益增长的复杂性对高效的设计流程提出了要求，然而EDA脚本编写仍然是一个瓶颈：专有API的文档稀少，错误往往表现为静默失败或晦涩难懂的异常。人工构建的知识虽然有所帮助，但随着工具链的演进却难以维护。我们提出了ZhuLong-SE（自进化），这是一个以执行结果为依据的LLM智能体，能够从以往的任务轨迹中学习可复用的知识。在ZhuLong的基础上，它通过API检索、文档响应、隔离沙箱执行和静态检查增强了任务级测试框架，并进一步引入了受约束的跨任务自进化机制。除了解决单个任务之外，ZhuLong-SE还将历史执行轨迹提炼为一个三层记忆库，该记忆库由真值锚定、证伪过滤、留出集回滚和防泄漏检索等机制加以约束管理。在包含158个任务的EDA-Eval-PyAether基准测试中，完整的任务级框架（在禁用自进化的情况下）……
tldr: ZhuLong-SE是一个以执行结果为依据的LLM智能体，通过将历史执行轨迹提炼为受真值锚定、证伪过滤、回滚和防泄漏检索等多重机制约束的三层记忆库，实现EDA脚本编写任务的跨任务自进化，从而超越依赖人工构建知识的局限。
en_tdlr: ZhuLong-SE is an execution-grounded LLM agent for EDA scripting that distills past execution traces into a governed three-tier memory store, enabling cross-task self-evolution beyond human-crafted knowledge.
